metaDescription: Toronto Deck Stainers won our 2026 Deck & Fence Staining award for Toronto, Ontario. Over 1,500 completed projects since 2008 across the GTA area.
summary: Toronto Deck Stainers has completed over 1,500 deck staining, sealing and restoration projects across the Greater Toronto Area since 2008. The company builds its reputation on honest assessment, recommending the level of prep a deck actually needs rather than the fastest option.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: Toronto Deck Stainers offers deck staining, sealing, refinishing and restoration, along with fence staining and power washing. Combining deck and fence staining lets a homeowner match colour and finish across a whole backyard rather than treating each surface separately.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: The company uses premium, low-VOC penetrating stains engineered for Canadian freeze-thaw cycles, and describes its approach as honest assessment, meaning it recommends the correct level of surface preparation rather than skipping steps to speed up a job. Since 2008, it has completed over 1,500 projects across Toronto, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Markham, Mississauga and Oakville.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: One reviewer described a deck that was grey and peeling after only three years, saying the company's full assessment and thorough prep work brought it back to better than new condition. Another said the company was the only one of three quotes to recommend a full sand-down before staining, and that the result justified the more thorough approach.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The company serves Toronto, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Markham, Mississauga and Oakville, covering a wide span of the Greater Toronto Area. Homeowners outside these named cities should confirm coverage before booking.

strengths: Over 1,500 completed projects since 2008, a substantial track record specific to deck and fence staining.
Uses low-VOC penetrating stains engineered specifically for Canadian freeze-thaw conditions.
Reviews specifically credit the company with recommending thorough prep, including full sand-downs, over shortcuts.
Covers both deck and fence staining, useful for matching finish across a full backyard.
Serves a wide, named list of GTA cities rather than a single municipality.
considerations: Best suited to homeowners who want thorough prep work, which may mean a higher quote than a competitor skipping sanding or stripping.
Staining is weather-dependent work, so expect scheduling to concentrate in warmer, drier months.
Not a fit if you want composite decking installed instead of maintaining existing wood; this business is staining and restoration focused.
Popular GTA-wide service means booking ahead is worthwhile during peak spring and summer demand.
bestFor: Homeowners whose deck has greyed or started peeling within a few years of a previous stain job
Anyone who has received a lowball quote elsewhere and wants a second opinion on required prep
GTA homeowners wanting matching deck and fence staining in one visit
Wood decks and fences needing power washing and resealing as routine maintenance
questionsToAsk: Based on our deck's current condition, do you recommend a full sand-down or a lighter cleaning and reseal?
Which stain product do you use, and how is it suited to freeze-thaw conditions specifically?
How long should we expect the new stain job to last before it needs reapplication?
Can you stain our fence to match the deck in the same visit?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: Toronto Deck Stainers was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top deck and fence staining company serving Toronto, Ontario, based on public services, project history and reviews, with no fee for consideration or winning.

faq.q: How many projects have they completed?
faq.a: The company states it has completed over 1,500 projects across the GTA since 2008.

faq.q: Why did reviewers mention a full sand-down?
faq.a: One reviewer noted the company recommended a full sand-down before staining rather than a quicker shortcut, which they said produced a noticeably better result.
Toronto, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Markham, Mississauga and Oakville.
